divorce.title: DIVORCE
divorce.description: Loss of partner's salary (n/a for singles).

car_accident_parked.title: CAR ACCIDENT
car_accident_parked.description: You drive into a parked car. Both cars are damaged.

car_accident_hail.title: CAR ACCIDENT
car_accident_hail.description: A heavy hailstorm causes a lot of damage to your car.

car_accident_traffic_jam.title: CAR ACCIDENT
car_accident_traffic_jam.description: You hit another car in a traffic jam. In addition to the damage to several cars, you have also suffered an injury.

inheritance.title: INHERITANCE
inheritance.description: Roll the dice. Each crossed circle under 'Time with the family' on your character sheet = 1 extra roll. The best throw counts.

storm_damage_trampoline.title: STORM DAMAGE
storm_damage_trampoline.description: Your trampoline damages the neighbour's pool house. Do you have family insurance?

storm_damage_roof.title: STORM DAMAGE
storm_damage_roof.description: Your roof tiles fly through your neighbour's window. Do you have a fire insurance?

dismissal.title: DISMISSAL / JOB LOSS
dismissal.description: Loss is determined by what you chose under 'Education and training' on your character sheet.

promotion.title: PROMOTION
promotion.description: Promotion is determined by what you chose under 'Education and training' on your character sheet.

new_job.title: NEW (DIFFERENT) JOB
new_job.description: Roll the dice. Each crossed circle under 'Education and training' on your character sheet = 1 extra roll. The best throw counts.

illness_work.title: ILLNESS
illness_work.description: You are ill and cannot work for a while. (*You are only self-employed if this is explicitly stated on your character sheet)

financial_support.title: FINANCIAL SUPPORT
financial_support.description: Roll the dice. Each crossed circle under 'Time with the family' on your character sheet = 1 extra roll. The best throw counts.

holiday.title: ON HOLIDAY
holiday.description: Time for a holiday! Roll the dice to choose your destination.

leaking_roof.title: LEAKING ROOF
leaking_roof.description: The roof needs to be replaced. You cannot make an insurance claim.

illness_dice.title: ILLNESS
illness_dice.description: Roll the dice. Each crossed circle under 'Healthy living' on your character sheet = 1 extra roll. The best throw counts.

housing_costs.title: HOUSING COSTS
housing_costs.description: Roll the dice. Each crossed circle under 'Social life' and/or 'Volunteer work' on your character sheet = 1 extra roll. The best throw counts.

depression.title: DEPRESSION / BURNOUT / BOREOUT
depression.description: Roll the dice. Each crossed circle under 'Healthy living' and/or 'Social life' on your character sheet = 1 extra roll. The best throw counts.

event_cards.roll_instruction: What does fate have in store?
event_cards.check_insurance: Which insurance do you have? Check your calculation sheet.
